name: Songstream
tagline: Play Civitai collections like a music player.
description:
Songstream plays the videos in a Civitai collection one after another, like a music player. It starts with the Music Focus collection. Your own collections appear beside it, and any public collection opens from its link. Star tracks to save them to your private Favorites playlist.

Shuffle and repeat, a queue that shows what already played, keyboard shortcuts, and media keys and lock-screen controls where your browser allows them. The Details tab shows how the current video was made: its prompt, settings and resources. With your permission, you can see and change your public Civitai reactions on eligible videos. Comments open on Civitai.

It remembers your favorites, volume, shuffle and repeat, the playlist you had on, and collections you opened by link. Only you can see these, and you can empty them from your Civitai account settings.

scopeJustifications.social:react:self: Show the viewer's existing reactions and let them add or remove a public Civitai reaction on a video playing in Songstream. Ask for consent when they first use a reaction button.

playback.description: Playback, batched: tracks that really started and seconds played since the last batch, with the playlist kind and play mode.

favorite_changed.description: The viewer starred or unstarred a track, and where they clicked.
